text: Binary per-row flag: returns 1 if at least one other-user comment (parsed from the OC_comments JSON list, excluding OP comments) asserts that a proposition or claim made by the OP in title or argument (used as context to identify claims) is false, incorrect or logically unsound, i.e. disputes its truth rather than describing consequences. Quoted material counts only if the commenter adopts it; comments that only add harms, offer opinions or agree don't count. Ignores OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting the outcome, in any field (generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not outcome reporting); list order is irrelevant. Returns 0 if the list is valid (including empty) and no comment qualifies; null if OC_comments is missing/malformed or if both title and argument are missing.
